summary: The exported JSON-lines bundle was parsed as the external evaluator would: the embedded diff string was written verbatim and had the same hash as the standalone patch; the diff headers showed exactly one target source file; git apply --check and git apply succeeded on a fresh pristine tree and the applied file hash equaled the repaired working copy. The evaluator payload reproduces the exact verified tree and behavior.
